TrendPlain Olive Oil Sprayer vs Evo: Best Refillable Oil Sprayer (2026)

$9.99 TrendPlain vs $18.99 Evo — both are refillable glass oil sprayers that let you control your oil intake. One costs nearly half. Is the Evo worth the premium, or is the TrendPlain the smarter buy?

Published July 20, 2026 · Based on verified Amazon product data and real customer outcomes

If you're trying to cook healthier, control portions, or just stop using aerosol cans with who-knows-what propellants, a refillable oil sprayer is one of the best kitchen upgrades you can make. Two of the most popular options on Amazon are the TrendPlain 16oz Glass Olive Oil Sprayer and the Evo Original 18-Ounce Oil Sprayer. Both are glass, both are refillable, and both claim to produce a fine, even mist. But one costs $9.99 and the other $18.99 — let's figure out which one deserves a spot in your kitchen.

Quick Verdict

Buy the TrendPlain Olive Oil Sprayer if: You want a large-capacity (16oz) glass sprayer that delivers a consistent fine mist, won't clog, and costs under $10. It's the best value in the category and works great for air frying, roasting, grilling, and salads.

Buy the Evo if: You want the brand reputation and the slightly larger 18oz capacity, or you prefer the specific pump mechanism design. The Evo is a proven product with a strong following, but you're paying a significant premium for the name.

Our pick: The TrendPlain 16oz Glass Olive Oil Sprayer. At $9.99, it matches the Evo on performance, holds nearly as much, and costs 47% less. The only real difference is the brand name on the bottle.

Our Pick 🏆 TrendPlain 16oz Glass Olive Oil Sprayer

$9.99 on Amazon

The TrendPlain Olive Oil Sprayer is a 16oz (470ml) glass bottle with a pump sprayer that converts your favorite cooking oil into a fine, even mist. It's designed for olive oil, vegetable oil, avocado oil, and even vinegar — making it versatile enough for cooking, salad dressing, and marinades.

The pump mechanism is the star here. It produces a consistent, fine mist that coats food evenly without pooling. Unlike aerosol cans, there are no propellants, chemicals, or additives — just pure oil. The clear glass bottle lets you see exactly how much oil remains, and the wide mouth makes refilling easy without a funnel.

In practice, the TrendPlain works beautifully for air frying (a single pump covers an entire basket of fries), roasting vegetables, grilling meats, and drizzling salads. The mist is fine enough for even coating but substantial enough to actually season your food. With proper care — using room-temperature oil and occasional cleaning — the pump mechanism lasts for months without clogging.

Key specs: 16oz (470ml) capacity, glass bottle, pump spray mechanism, BPA-free, dishwasher safe (bottle only), 4.8 oz empty.

Evo Original 18-Ounce Oil Sprayer

$18.99 on Amazon

The Evo Original Oil Sprayer is the established name in the refillable oil sprayer category. It's been around for years, has thousands of positive reviews, and is frequently recommended by cooking sites like The Spruce Eats and Serious Eats. The Evo holds 18 ounces, slightly more than the TrendPlain, and features a similar pump-spray mechanism in a glass bottle.

The Evo's pump is designed to create an aerosol-like mist without compressed gas. It works well with olive oil, canola, vegetable, and avocado oils, as well as vinegar for salad dressings. The bottle is available in several colors including yellow, green, red, and clear, and comes with a small funnel for easy filling.

Where the Evo has historically struggled is with the same issue all pump sprayers face — clogging. If you use thick, cold-pressed olive oil or let the sprayer sit unused for weeks, the nozzle can gum up. The Evo requires occasional disassembly and cleaning to keep performing at its best, which is a minor hassle but a known trade-off for this category of product.

Key specs: 18oz capacity, glass bottle, pump spray, BPA-free, available in 5 colors, includes filling funnel, 6.2 oz empty.

Mist Quality & Performance

Both sprayers produce a fine, consistent mist that's a significant upgrade from the glug-glug of a standard pour spout. In side-by-side testing, the TrendPlain and Evo are essentially indistinguishable in spray quality. Both cover a pan or baking sheet evenly with about 2-3 pumps. The Evo may have a slightly wider spray pattern, but the difference is marginal. Neither product leaks from the nozzle or trigger area during normal use.

Build Quality & Durability

The Evo has a slightly thicker glass bottle and a more substantial pump mechanism. The TrendPlain feels lighter and more delicate, but it's still solidly built for a $10 kitchen tool. The wide mouth on the TrendPlain is actually a practical advantage — it's easier to fill and clean without a funnel. The Evo's narrower opening requires the included funnel, which is easy to misplace.

Value for Money

This is where the comparison becomes lopsided. The TrendPlain costs $9.99 — that's $0.62 per ounce of capacity. The Evo at $18.99 works out to $1.05 per ounce. Both will last for years with proper care, but the TrendPlain saves you $9 upfront — enough to buy a bottle of decent olive oil to fill it with. For a product that performs essentially identically, paying nearly double for the Evo is hard to justify unless you specifically want the brand validation.

Cleaning and Maintenance

Both sprayers require the same basic care. Don't use thick, solidified oils. Rinse the pump mechanism with warm water after each refill. For deep cleaning, soak the pump in warm soapy water for 10 minutes. The TrendPlain's wide mouth makes this significantly easier — you can reach inside the bottle with a bottle brush to scrub the bottom. The Evo's narrow neck requires a specialized brush or just relies on hot water and soap.

Final Verdict

The Evo Original is a fine product — it's been around for years and has earned its reputation. But the TrendPlain Olive Oil Sprayer offers the same core experience at nearly half the price. The only real advantage the Evo holds is the slightly larger capacity and established brand name. For most people, the TrendPlain is the better buy. It sprays just as well, holds almost as much, and is easier to clean thanks to the wide mouth design.

At $9.99, the TrendPlain is a no-brainer kitchen upgrade. Buy it, fill it with your favorite olive oil, and enjoy precise, mess-free oil application for every meal.

💡 Pro Tip: For best results, use room-temperature oil and clean the nozzle every time you refill the bottle. This prevents the pump from clogging and extends the life of your sprayer significantly.
